data.body_html:
If you are looking for a Marbella boat rental for an Estepona fishing charter, you have come to the right place. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes from the best fishing grounds off Estepona. Whether you want a speedboat for a quick session or a luxury yacht for a full day, we have options from €749 for 2 hours. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. No hidden fees.

Why Choose a Marbella Boat Rental for Estepona Fishing?

Estepona offers some of the best inshore fishing on the Costa del Sol. The waters around Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are rich with sea bass, bream, and mackerel. Deeper waters further out can yield tuna and dorado. By departing from Puerto Banús, you save time and get straight to the action. Our skippers know the local spots and can adapt the trip to your skill level.

Our Fleet for Estepona Fishing Charters

We have 20+ boats ranging from 6.4m to 29m. For small groups (up to 5 guests), the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are ideal. For up to 10 guests, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) or Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) offer speed and comfort. Larger parties of 12 can choose the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax). All boats are well-maintained and equipped with safety gear.

Pricing and What's Included

Our pricing is transparent. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, €1,099 for 4 hours, €1,599 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, including white and grey variants) start at €4,719 for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. For all other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%).

Best Fishing Spots Near Estepona

Our skippers typically head to Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés for inshore fishing. These rocky areas hold bream, sea bass, and wrasse. For larger pelagics, we go further out to the deep drop-offs. The skipper will adjust the route based on weather, season, and your preferences. You can also combine fishing with a visit to Estepona's beautiful coastline.

What to Bring for Your Fishing Charter

We provide all drinks and snacks, but you should bring sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses, and a light jacket (sea breeze can be cool). Fishing gear is not included, but you can bring your own or ask us to arrange rental rods and tackle. A fishing license is required for anglers over 14 – we can help you get one. Don't forget a camera for the catch!

How to Book Your Marbella Boat Rental for Estepona Fishing

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability and get a quote. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during summer. We will confirm your boat, departure time, and skipper. For more information on our full fleet, visit our [Marbella boat rental](/ ) page.
